name: file_name_search
description: Find corpus files by original upload name and/or relative path substring (and optional glob). Does not search file contents. Prefer this when the user names a document (including Turkish/spaced .docx titles); then call file_read with the returned technical path. Candidates include source_filename/display_name when known. For text inside files use file_search.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against original upload names, basenames, and relative paths (e.g. Saha İnceleme Formu.docx or content.md).

glob.description: Optional filename glob relative to corpus (e.g. **/*.md).
